entities.summary: The Lomnica Monastery, also known as the Lovnica Monastery, is the 16th century Serbian Orthodox monastery dedicated to Saint George. It is located near Šekovići in the region of Donji Birač in eastern Republika Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
